## Our model now

On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.

- **Box:** 10.8 × 7.3 m, storeyed hall
- **Heights:** platform 0.45 m, eave 5.95 m, ridge 8.68 m above the ground
- **Roof:** hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile
- **Faces:** 82.2° from north
- **Drawn:** by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, 歇山 hip-and-gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).
- **Confidence:** B

  > 鴻慈永祜東垣外徑連岡三重度橋而東則彚芳書院也内宇為抒藻軒後為涵逺齋齋前西垣内為翠照樓東垣内為倬雲樓又東為眉月軒倬雲樓南稍東為隨安室又東敞宇三楹為問津逾溪橋數武有石坊為斷橋殘雪（圓明園册）臣等謹按彚芳書院四十景之一額為皇上御書倬雲樓中楹額曰竹深荷淨與院内諸額皆御書涵逺齋内聨曰寳案凝香圖書陳道法仙臺麗景晴雨驗耕桑亦御書問津額為世宗御書
  East of the wall of 鴻慈永祜, over three ridges: 彚芳書院 with 抒藻軒, 涵逺齋, 翠照樓, 倬雲樓, 眉月軒, 隨安室, the three-bay 問津, and a stone arch 斷橋殘雪 beyond a footbridge.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 3x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
